result_reason: The primary selective profile is usable and native GPU MTP accepts live drafts, but natural cold promotion/use is unproven. L32768 continuation fails in the current CUDA source, and L131072 is allocation plus a 512-token smoke only.

definitions.C: committed or requested occupied prompt tokens for the row
definitions.H: physical hot target capacity in tokens; page capacity is H/256
definitions.A: observed attended/selected row capacity, not normalized attention mass
definitions.B_U: configured batch/ubatch tokens; effective ubatch was 64
definitions.pp_tg: server prompt/prefill and predicted/decode tokens per second
definitions.mtp: live draft proposals/accepted target tokens; allocation or draft capacity alone is not acceptance

rows.failure: illegal device memory access at ggml_backend_cuda_synchronize; service exited and systemd restarted it

canonical_primary.matched_conditions: L8192/C6144, selective, H4096, A4096, B/U128/64, Turbo4 target and native Turbo4 GPU MTP
canonical_primary.ratio_reason: The all-GPU control uses A8192 while selective uses A4096; the CPU-main-KV/GPU-MTP control was not run because no safe spare VRAM was available.

measurement_classes.synthetic_cuda_kernel: No standalone synthetic-kernel throughput record is present in the named 29-01/29-02 artifacts; the focused CPU/CUDA execution fixture passed route/lifetime assertions but supplies no token-rate result. Direct-route/q0 results are server measurements and are not presented as synthetic kernel wins.
measurement_classes.all_resident: The off control is a dense all-GPU arithmetic ceiling/control, not an offload comparison.
measurement_classes.warm_selective: Primary selective and incremental rows are warm/selected-path measurements with host backing; zero H2D means they do not prove real cold offload speed.
measurement_classes.cold_latency: The natural recall TTFT is 292127 us, but no cold page moved, so it is not a cold-miss latency measurement.
measurement_classes.allocation_only: L131072 is allocation plus smoke; larger capacity does not imply a successfully populated context.

tradeoffs_and_limits.normal_use: B/U=128/64 consistently resolved to effective U=64. H4096 reached C6148 while host backing grew to 15 pages; H16384 and H65536 admitted at approximately 276.8 MB and 1.107 GB target pools, consuming headroom without proving useful cold recall.
tradeoffs_and_limits.sparse_approximation: Selection uses bounded GPU/host summary and router settings (top-k 8, explore 1 in scale); A is selected-row coverage and the score is an approximate ranking heuristic, not attention mass. No exact hybrid CPU attention or natural H2D promotion was proven.
tradeoffs_and_limits.mtp: Full-L Turbo4/GPU draft placement is configured at every scale row, but only the live small q0/incremental and first 32K append show accepted drafts. The 131K smoke is 2/0; capacity/admission is not a full-L MTP acceptance claim.

critical_path: The selected primary trace repeatedly rebuilt/submitted graphs (no replay), changed the table per generation, read large host summary volumes, and performed asynchronous host seals. These are measured control/movement facts; wait_time_us and queue_time_us overlap and are not summed or relabelled as CPU cost.
Completed offload-path rows show host seal D2H and host-valid pages but h2d_useful_bytes=0, faults=0, and no transfer submissions. Promotion mailbox/publication/use remains the unproven product path.

The cheapest scale continuation reproducer is the existing L32768/H16384 run: one 1200-token append followed by a 1400-token append at B/U128/64. The second append faults at ggml_backend_cuda_synchronize after 136.16 s.
